Coordinates with other executives and departments. Upskill leadership and teams across the business to use AI and data effectively, building broad digital and AI literacy, not just capability within the technology function. Core technology leadership Lead, develop and manage the technology function, including the IT manager, BIM & Digital Lead, Data & Analytics Lead. Oversee core IT infrastructure, systems, cyber security and data protection across all office and project locations. Own the Data Protection and data Management governance across the global organisation. Manage technology budgets, vendor and partner relationships, and procurement of hardware, software and digital services, balancing innovation investment with cost discipline. Partner with the CFO, COO and CPO to embed technology and AI into finance, operations, people and commercial processes. Report to the CEO and Board on technology performance, transformation progress, AI adoption, risk and investment priorities. We hold ourselves to a high standard of Accountability, taking ownership of our commitments, and act with Integrity in every decision we make. We pursue Excellence in everything we do, continuously improving how we design, build and operate, and we place Safety at the centre of our culture, ensuring the wellbeing of our people is never compromised.
